description: List the workbooks in the user's Library: the files this account owns, newest-updated first, including everything save_to_library saved. Use it to find a library_file_id to open with create_session, or to check that a save landed. Returns {files: [{library_file_id, name, size_bytes, created_at, updated_at, latest_version: {seq, message, created_at}}], truncated}, times in ISO 8601; latest_version is the newest saved version and its name. Pass query to match part of a file name (ignoring case) and limit for how many to return (1-200, default 50); truncated is true when more files match, so narrow the query or raise limit. Shared files and the trash are left out. Fails with library_unavailable when the Library isn't connected. Reads your Basis Library through the API (needs an API key).

query.description: Part of a file name to match, ignoring case, e.g. "pro forma" (omit for every file)

name: list_library_files
title: List Library files
